items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 2 September 2026 5:47am
items.description:

2-7


##Wind Speed##

13

SW

SW soon backing S or SE 10-15, veering SW this afternoon, then W or SW 15-20 tonight.

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or coastal mist. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.
